about: The build questions used to choose the heads: with_disclaimer = questions whose no-edit reply had a disclaimer (blind reader), without_disclaimer = questions whose reply had none, the same number per group. before = first selection, from replies with token limit 1024 (build/no_edit.limit1024.json; some 'without' replies had been cut off). after = second selection, from finished replies only (build/no_edit.limit2048.json).
